# NEW 2026-11-18 theme stages 4-5 (strategoi and the throne). Generated by gen_theme_usurp.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# Theme scope. Monthly bookkeeping for the throne checks.
oe_theme_usurp_theme_monthly = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_theme_army value = regular_army_size }
}

# BYZ scope. Route A: rebels of a theme revolt holding Constantinople for 6 months.
oe_theme_usurp_monthly = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            has_variable = oe_theme_revolt_active
            var:oe_theme_revolt_country ?= { has_ruler = yes }
        }
        var:oe_theme_revolt_country = { save_scope_as = oe_usurp_rebels }
        if = {
            limit = { location:constantinople = { controller ?= scope:oe_usurp_rebels } }
            # change_variable does not create a missing variable (r2 test: the counter never started).
            if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_theme_usurp_months } } set_variable = { name = oe_theme_usurp_months value = 0 } }
            change_variable = { name = oe_theme_usurp_months add = 1 }
            if = { limit = { var:oe_theme_usurp_months >= 6 } oe_theme_usurp = yes }
        }
        else = { set_variable = { name = oe_theme_usurp_months value = 0 } }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_theme_usurp_months }
        remove_variable = oe_theme_usurp_months
    }
}

# BYZ scope. The rebel general enters the city and takes the throne; the rebel state rejoins the empire.
oe_theme_usurp = {
    var:oe_theme_revolt_country = { save_scope_as = oe_usurp_rebels ruler = { save_scope_as = oe_usurp_general } }
    # r2 test: killing the court and annexing while the rebels still held Constantinople made the engine settle the
    # civil war for the rebels (the player was moved to a new country without themes, organisations or ruler).
    # So: take the general out, hand the occupied cities back, end the war by annexation while the old emperor lives,
    # and only then change the ruler.
    # A coup ends the regency storyline: the author's Kantakouzenos event must not fire when Andronikos III is killed.
    set_variable = oe_nf_kantakouzenos_ambition_seen
    ruler ?= { save_scope_as = oe_usurp_old_ruler }
    heir ?= { save_scope_as = oe_usurp_old_heir }
    regent ?= { save_scope_as = oe_usurp_old_regent }
    ruler ?= { dynasty ?= { save_scope_as = oe_tg_old_dynasty } }   # gen_theme_houses.py
    scope:oe_usurp_general = { move_country = c:BYZ }
    every_owned_location = {
        limit = { controller ?= scope:oe_usurp_rebels }
        change_location_controller = c:BYZ
    }
    annex_country = { country = scope:oe_usurp_rebels reason = Diplomatic transfer = yes }
    # Same order as the author's coup (oe_bi_coup): heir first, the sovereign last.
    scope:oe_usurp_old_heir ?= { if = { limit = { is_alive = yes NOT = { this = scope:oe_usurp_general } } kill_character_silently = this } }
    scope:oe_usurp_old_regent ?= { if = { limit = { is_alive = yes NOT = { this = scope:oe_usurp_general } } kill_character_silently = this } }
    scope:oe_usurp_old_ruler ?= { if = { limit = { is_alive = yes NOT = { this = scope:oe_usurp_general } } kill_character_silently = this } }
    set_new_ruler = scope:oe_usurp_general
    oe_tg_after_usurp = yes   # gen_theme_houses.py: the deposed dynasty becomes a great house
    add_legitimacy = -100
    add_legitimacy = 30
    add_stability = stability_mild_penalty
    add_stability = stability_mild_penalty
    every_subject = {
        limit = { oe_theme_member_trigger = yes }
        set_variable = { name = oe_theme_loyalty value = 50 }
    }
    remove_variable = oe_theme_usurp_months
    remove_variable = oe_theme_revolt_active
    remove_variable = oe_theme_revolt_country
    oe_court_clear_invalid = yes
    oe_court_auto_fill = yes
    oe_nf_refresh = yes
    trigger_event_non_silently = oe_theme_usurp.3
}

# BYZ scope. Called by the intrigue disaster instead of firing its coup event directly.
# 40% of the time an ambitious strategos leads the coup; otherwise the author's coup event fires.
oe_theme_coup_dispatch = {
    remove_variable = oe_theme_coup_theme
    if = {
        limit = { any_subject = { oe_theme_ambitious = yes } }
        random = {
            chance = 40
            ordered_subject = {
                limit = { oe_theme_ambitious = yes }
                order_by = regular_army_size
                save_scope_as = oe_coup_theme
            }
            if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_coup_theme } set_variable = { name = oe_theme_coup_theme value = scope:oe_coup_theme } }
        }
    }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_theme_coup_theme } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_theme_usurp.4 }
    else = { trigger_event_non_silently = oe_byzantine_intrigue.4 }
}

# BYZ scope; var:oe_theme_coup_theme is the strategos's theme. Route B.
oe_theme_general_coup = {
    if = {
        limit = { var:oe_theme_coup_theme ?= { has_ruler = yes } }
        var:oe_theme_coup_theme = { save_scope_as = oe_coup_theme ruler = { save_scope_as = oe_usurp_general } }
    # A coup ends the regency storyline: the author's Kantakouzenos event must not fire when Andronikos III is killed.
    set_variable = oe_nf_kantakouzenos_ambition_seen
    ruler ?= { save_scope_as = oe_usurp_old_ruler }
    heir ?= { save_scope_as = oe_usurp_old_heir }
    regent ?= { save_scope_as = oe_usurp_old_regent }
    ruler ?= { dynasty ?= { save_scope_as = oe_tg_old_dynasty } }   # gen_theme_houses.py
    # Same order as the author's coup (oe_bi_coup): heir first, the sovereign last.
    scope:oe_usurp_old_heir ?= { if = { limit = { is_alive = yes NOT = { this = scope:oe_usurp_general } } kill_character_silently = this } }
    scope:oe_usurp_old_regent ?= { if = { limit = { is_alive = yes NOT = { this = scope:oe_usurp_general } } kill_character_silently = this } }
    scope:oe_usurp_old_ruler ?= { if = { limit = { is_alive = yes NOT = { this = scope:oe_usurp_general } } kill_character_silently = this } }
    scope:oe_usurp_general = { move_country = c:BYZ }
    set_new_ruler = scope:oe_usurp_general
    oe_tg_after_usurp = yes   # gen_theme_houses.py: the deposed dynasty becomes a great house
        annex_country = { country = scope:oe_coup_theme reason = Diplomatic transfer = yes }
        every_subject = {
            limit = { oe_theme_member_trigger = yes }
            change_variable = { name = oe_theme_loyalty add = -10 }
            clamp_variable = { name = oe_theme_loyalty min = 0 max = 100 }
        }
    oe_court_clear_invalid = yes
    oe_court_auto_fill = yes
    oe_nf_refresh = yes
    }
    remove_variable = oe_theme_coup_theme
}

# Any scope; scope:oe_recall_theme is the theme whose strategos is recalled (进京述职).
# Saves scope value oe_recall_blocked when the recall does not happen.
oe_theme_recall_risk = {
	if = {
		limit = { exists = international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars }
	    if = {
	        limit = { scope:oe_recall_theme = { var:oe_theme_loyalty_band ?= 0 } }
	        random = {
	            chance = 30
	            scope:oe_recall_theme = { set_variable = oe_theme_revolt_now }
	            save_scope_value_as = { name = oe_recall_blocked value = 2 }
	            c:BYZ = { set_variable = { name = oe_theme_recall_target value = scope:oe_recall_theme } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_theme_usurp.2 }
	        }
	    }
	    else_if = {
	        limit = { scope:oe_recall_theme = { var:oe_theme_loyalty_band ?= 1 } }
	        random = {
	            chance = 25
	            scope:oe_recall_theme = {
	                change_variable = { name = oe_theme_loyalty add = -5 }
	                clamp_variable = { name = oe_theme_loyalty min = 0 max = 100 }
	            }
	            international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars = { change_variable = { name = oe_pillars_authority add = -1 } }
	            save_scope_value_as = { name = oe_recall_blocked value = 1 }
	            c:BYZ = { set_variable = { name = oe_theme_recall_target value = scope:oe_recall_theme } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_theme_usurp.1 }
	        }
	    }
	}
}

# Theme scope. 收缴兵权: half the theme's armies (rounded up) pass to the empire.
oe_theme_disarm = {
	if = {
		limit = { exists = international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars }
	    save_scope_as = oe_disarm_theme
	    set_variable = { name = oe_theme_disarm_cd years = 10 }
	    change_variable = { name = oe_theme_loyalty add = -10 }
	    clamp_variable = { name = oe_theme_loyalty min = 0 max = 100 }
	    set_variable = { name = oe_theme_disarm_flip value = 0 }
	    every_army = {
	        if = {
	            limit = { scope:oe_disarm_theme = { NOT = { var:oe_theme_disarm_flip ?= 1 } } }   # '?=': option tooltips dry-run this without the set_variable (r5)
	            change_unit_owner = c:BYZ
	            scope:oe_disarm_theme = { set_variable = { name = oe_theme_disarm_flip value = 1 } }
	        }
	        else = { scope:oe_disarm_theme = { set_variable = { name = oe_theme_disarm_flip value = 0 } } }
	    }
	    remove_variable = oe_theme_disarm_flip
	    international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars = { change_variable = { name = oe_pillars_authority add = -3 } }
	    set_variable = { name = oe_theme_army value = regular_army_size }
	}
}
